business_process: Contractor start requests and assignment support
description: Entering start requests (SSN; date of birth; pay and bill rates) in the partner portal; extensions, rate changes, and ending assignments; answering contractor and client questions
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: A contractor whose start request is not entered cannot start on the agreed day; the margin share on 11 contractors (about $9,750 a month) depends on keeping them on assignment. Contractor pay itself does not depend on the owner: clients approve timesheets in the partner portal and the partner runs payroll
manual_workaround: Phone the partner's account manager to enter a start request by voice (never by email with an SSN); clients keep approving time directly

description: Sending shortlisted candidates to clients; scheduling and preparing interviews; collecting feedback; extending direct-hire offers for clients
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Active searches are won by the first good submittal; a missed interview or a candidate lost to another recruiter can cost a whole direct-hire fee (about $12,500); RPO set by the ATS vendor's daily backups (email is near real time)
manual_workaround: Call candidates and client hiring managers from the phone using the printed open-searches sheet; resend submittals from the email sent folder
dependent_third_parties: ATS vendor; email provider; phone carrier
dependent_people_or_facilities: Owner-recruiter (single point of failure); home office

description: Posting job ads; reviewing applicants and AI match scores in the ATS; sourcing on the networking site; phone screens
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Searches slow down but recover within days; the regulatory impact is Moderate because screening must stay free of discrimination even during an outage (no shortcuts such as automatic rejection)
manual_workaround: Review applicants in the job boards' own inboxes and the networking site; keep notes in a dated spreadsheet in the file storage and load them into the ATS after recovery
dependent_third_parties: ATS vendor; job boards; networking site

description: Direct-hire fee invoices; checking the partner's monthly margin statement; bank reconciliation by the bookkeeper
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Invoices are due on the candidate's start date and payable in 30 days; a delay of a few days does not lose revenue; personal savings cover about two months of expenses
manual_workaround: Invoice from a saved template by email; check the partner deposit in online banking
dependent_third_parties: Accounting SaaS vendor; outside bookkeeper; bank

description: Client fee agreements and e-signature; insurance; records; business correspondence
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Administrative deadlines are measured in days or weeks
manual_workaround: Paper copies of current fee agreements in the home office; sign on paper and scan
